<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>DeeMarine Maritime Intelligence — Edition 2</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#06121e;--panel:#0d1c2b;--panel2:#10263a;--line:#24415a;--text:#eaf4fb;--muted:#8fa8bd;
  --cyan:#39c4df;--cyan2:#78e4f1;--red:#ff5f67;--green:#42d992;--amber:#ffbf5a;--blue:#6fa9ff;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box} html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% -10%,#12304a 0,#06121e 36%,#04101a 100%);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}
button,select{font:inherit}
.app{min-height:100vh;display:flex}
.sidebar{width:248px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(4,13,22,.93);padding:20px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);z-index:20}
.brand{font-weight:900;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:1px;margin:2px 10px}.brand span{color:var(--cyan)}
.edition{margin:5px 10px 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.8px}
.nav-label{margin:18px 10px 8px;color:#62809a;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.nav button{width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;color:#b8cad8;text-align:left;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:9px;margin:2px 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.nav button:hover,.nav button.active{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#12304a,#0c2134);color:#fff}
.main{flex:1;min-width:0}.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:15;padding:16px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(6,18,30,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.title{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}.subtitle{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}.filters{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
select{background:#0b1c2d;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#dae8f2;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px}
.content{padding:22px 24px 44px}.page{display:none}.page.active{display:block}
.hero{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:15px}.hero h1{margin:0;font-size:28px}.hero p{margin:7px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;max-width:900px}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:15px;background:#102b40;color:#9dc3da;font-size:10px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:16px 0}.kpi{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#10253a,#0b1928);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px}.kpi .label{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}.kpi .value{font-size:23px;font-weight:800;margin-top:4px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:14px}.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:14px}.card{background:rgba(10,27,43,.88);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:15px}.card h3{margin:0 0 11px;font-size:13px}.hint{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.barrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:145px 1fr 32px;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:10px}.bar{height:8px;background:#183047;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}.fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--cyan2));border-radius:10px}.fill.risk{background:var(--red)}.fill.opp{background:var(--green)}.fill.mix{background:var(--amber)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px}th,td{padding:8px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e374c;vertical-align:top}th{text-align:left;color:#8ba6bb;font-weight:700}
a{color:var(--cyan2);text-decoration:none}a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.signal{display:inline-block;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:13px;font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap}.risk{background:rgba(255,95,103,.13);color:#ff9499}.opp{background:rgba(66,217,146,.13);color:#79eeb4}.mix{background:rgba(255,191,90,.13);color:#ffd590}.watch{background:rgba(111,169,255,.13);color:#aecbff}
.radar{height:330px;position:relative;border:1px dashed #2c4a63;border-radius:12px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#1a3a55 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:26px 26px;overflow:hidden}.axisx,.axisy{position:absolute;background:#335671}.axisx{left:6%;right:6%;top:50%;height:1px}.axisy{top:7%;bottom:7%;left:50%;width:1px}.q{position:absolute;color:#64849d;font-size:9px}.q.tl{left:8%;top:7%}.q.tr{right:8%;top:7%}.q.bl{left:8%;bottom:7%}.q.br{right:8%;bottom:7%}.dot{position:absolute;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.map{height:460px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#071727,#091d2e 72%,#071521);}.map:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(rgba(65,111,140,.07) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(65,111,140,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:42px 42px;opacity:.55}.worldmap-bg{position:absolute;inset:4% 2% 5% 2%;opacity:.96}.worldmap-bg svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}.map-caption{position:absolute;left:14px;top:12px;z-index:3;background:rgba(5,15,24,.78);border:1px solid #29475f;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:10px;color:#9db6c8}.port{position:absolute;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;z-index:6;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(57,196,223,.10),0 0 16px rgba(57,196,223,.32);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease,width .16s ease,height .16s ease}.port:hover,.port.selected{transform:translate(-0.5px,-0.5px) scale(1.55);z-index:20;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(57,196,223,.18),0 0 24px rgba(57,196,223,.50)}.port:focus{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}.port span{display:none}.map-legend{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:5;background:rgba(5,15,24,.82);border:1px solid #29475f;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:9px;color:#90a8ba;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.map-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}.map-legend i{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%}
.briefs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.brief{background:#0c2236;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:15px}.brief h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--cyan2);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}.brief p{margin:0;color:#c5d5e0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}
.detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:14px}.detailbox{background:#0c2134;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:15px}.detailbox h4{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px}.detailbox p{margin:0;color:#d3e0e8;line-height:1.6;font-size:11px}.detail-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.meta{padding:9px;border:1px solid #1e3a50;border-radius:9px;background:#0a1b2a}.meta small{display:block;color:#718da3;font-size:9px}.meta b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:11px}
.footer{margin-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;color:#66839a;font-size:9px}
.note{padding:12px 13px;background:#0a1d2c;border-left:3px solid var(--cyan);border-radius:8px;color:#c8d8e4;line-height:1.6;font-size:11px}
@media(max-width:1080px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.grid2,.detail{grid-template-columns:1fr}.grid3,.briefs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sidebar{width:220px}}
@media(max-width:760px){.app{display:block}.sidebar{width:100%;height:auto;position:static;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.nav{display:flex;overflow:auto}.nav-label{display:none}.nav button{min-width:max-content}.topbar{position:static;display:block}.filters{margin-top:10px;justify-content:flex-start}.content{padding:14px}.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.barrow{grid-template-columns:100px 1fr 28px}}
</style>

<style id="dma-refined-theme">
:root{
  --dma-navy:#071d3b;--dma-navy-2:#0a2a55;--dma-panel:#0e315f;--dma-panel-2:#123b70;
  --dma-cyan:#18b8ef;--dma-teal:#16b4ad;--dma-blue:#2966d9;--dma-light:#7fc2f3;
  --dma-gold:#f2b33d;--dma-red:#d83b2f;--dma-green:#1ab981;--dma-ink:#eef7ff;--dma-muted:#b5c9dc;
}
body{background:#061a33;color:var(--dma-ink);font-family:Inter,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif}
.app{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#06172d 0,#08254b 100%)}
.sidebar{width:235px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#071a35 0,#0a2b56 100%);border-right:1px solid rgba(75,164,235,.35);padding:18px 12px}
.brand-lockup{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;margin:0 4px 14px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.22);text-align:center}
.brand-lockup img{width:100%;max-width:165px;height:auto;display:block;margin:auto}
.sidebar .brand,.sidebar .edition{display:none}
.sidebar .nav-label{color:#58cfff;margin-top:14px}.nav button{border:1px solid transparent;color:#d5e7f4;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px}
.nav button:hover,.nav button.active{background:#0f3a70;border-color:#2a7ac0;color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--dma-cyan)}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,24,51,.97),rgba(9,52,96,.93));border-bottom:1px solid #2b6d9f;padding:15px 22px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.title{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.4px}.title:before{content:'DeeMarine ';color:#fff}.title{color:var(--dma-cyan)}
.subtitle{color:#d8eaf7;font-size:11px}.filters select{background:#0a2d58;border-color:#2b6d9f;color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px}
.content{padding:18px 20px 34px}.page{max-width:1520px;margin:0 auto}.hero{margin:0 0 12px}.hero h1{font-size:24px;color:#fff}.hero p{color:#aec6d9}.badge{background:#0f3a70;color:#8be1ff;border:1px solid #286da7}
.card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(16,52,98,.96),rgba(9,38,75,.96));border:1px solid rgba(66,148,211,.42);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.card h3{font-size:13px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.1px}
.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:14px 0}.kpi{min-height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#103867,#0a2b54);border:1px solid #2a70ac;border-radius:10px;padding:15px 16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.kpi:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-28px;top:-34px;width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(34,188,242,.15)}.kpi .label{color:#c8ddec;font-size:11px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:.1px}.kpi .value{font-size:32px;color:#fff;font-weight:900}.kpi .sub{font-size:10px;color:#90b4cf;margin-top:2px}
.exec-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.exec-grid .card{min-height:255px}.bars{gap:12px}.barrow{grid-template-columns:minmax(130px,1.2fr) 2fr 36px;font-size:11px}.bar{height:12px;background:#173c66}.fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#164c9b,#2cbaf2)}.fill.mix{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f4a51d,#ffd16a)}
.insight-panel{margin-top:12px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 2.85fr;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b2b56,#103f77);border:1px solid #2a70ac;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;min-height:190px}.insight-art{background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,rgba(42,188,239,.35),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(140deg,#0a1f3e,#0c4f7f);position:relative;min-height:190px}.insight-art:after{content:'⚓';font-size:94px;position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:.2}.insight-copy{padding:24px}.insight-kicker{color:#44cff4;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.insight-headline{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:var(--dma-gold);margin:7px 0 9px}.insight-copy p{margin:0;color:#e3f0f9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}.insight-tags{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px;color:#bde8fb;font-size:11px}.insight-tags span:before{content:'●';color:#22baf0;margin-right:6px}
.exec-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}.table-wrap{max-height:330px;overflow:auto;border-radius:8px}table{font-size:10px;background:#fff;color:#14314d;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}th{background:#e7f0f8;color:#18334d;font-weight:800;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2}td{border-bottom:1px solid #dce7f0}table a{color:#006f9f}.signal{font-weight:700}
.top5-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.top5-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr 100px;gap:10px;align-items:start;padding:10px;background:#fff;color:#18334d;border-radius:8px}.top5-rank{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#0d55a7;color:#fff;font-weight:900}.top5-title{font-weight:800;font-size:11px}.top5-meta{font-size:9px;color:#58708a;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.45}.top5-side{text-align:right;font-size:9px;color:#3f5a73}.top5-pill{display:inline-block;background:#e8f3ff;color:#0b5ba9;border-radius:11px;padding:3px 7px;margin-top:5px;font-size:8px;font-weight:800}
.footer{color:#9db8cc;border-top-color:#28557a;text-align:center;padding:14px 0 2px}
#executive .hero{display:none}
#allVerifiedCard h3:after{content:' • Sources linked';color:#5ed6ff;font-weight:500;font-size:10px}
@media(max-width:1180px){.exec-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.exec-grid .card:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}.exec-bottom{grid-template-columns:1fr}.insight-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr}.insight-art{min-height:120px}.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:760px){.sidebar{width:100%}.brand-lockup{max-width:220px}.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.exec-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.exec-grid .card:last-child{grid-column:auto}.topbar .title{font-size:21px}.insight-headline{font-size:21px}}
</style>

<style id="dma-ports-fix">
.port-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.port-insight-note{margin:10px 0 12px;padding:11px 13px;background:#0b2d57;border:1px solid #2a70ac;border-radius:9px;color:#cfe7f7;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55}
.port-insight-note b{color:#56d7ff}
@media(max-width:1180px){.port-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.port-grid .card:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media(max-width:760px){.port-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.port-grid .card:last-child{grid-column:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="brand-lockup"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="DeeMarine Analytics logo"></div>
  <div class="brand">DEE<span>MARINE</span></div>
  <div class="edition">MARITIME INTELLIGENCE • EDITION 2</div>
  <div class="nav-label">Report</div>
  <nav class="nav">
    <button class="active" data-page="executive">01 Executive Intelligence</button>
    <button data-page="map">02 Global Map</button>
    <button data-page="radar">03 Risk & Opportunity</button>
    <button data-page="ports">04 Ports & Infrastructure</button>
    <button data-page="trade">05 Trade & Logistics</button>
    <button data-page="themes">06 Energy / Digital / Security</button>
    <button data-page="brief">07 Intelligence Brief</button>
    <button data-page="method">Data & Methodology</button>
  </nav>
</aside>

<main class="main">
  <header class="topbar">
    <div>
      <div class="title">Maritime Intelligence</div>
      <div class="subtitle">From maritime developments to decision intelligence. • Latest report date: 10 October 2026 • Weekly consolidation: 5–10 October</div>
    </div>
    <div class="filters">
      <select id="edition" title="Choose report edition"><option value="Choose Edition">Choose Edition</option></select>
      <select id="region"><option>All Regions</option></select>
      <select id="category"><option>All Categories</option></select>
      <select id="impact"><option>All Impact</option><option>High</option><option>Medium</option><option>Low</option></select>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="content">
    <section class="page active" id="executive">
      <div class="hero"><div><h1>Executive Maritime Intelligence</h1><p>Weekly maritime developments, structured into data and translated into practical decision intelligence.</p></div><span class="badge" id="recordBadge">records</span></div>
      <div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
      <div class="exec-grid">
        <div class="card"><h3>Developments by Region</h3><div class="bars" id="regionBars"></div></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Developments by Category</h3><div class="bars" id="categoryBars"></div></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Impact Distribution</h3><div class="bars" id="impactBars"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="insight-panel">
        <div class="insight-art"></div>
        <div class="insight-copy">
          <div class="insight-kicker">💡 DeeMarine Insight of the Week</div>
          <div class="insight-headline" id="insightHeadline">What is the signal behind the headlines?</div>
          <p id="insightBody">The weekly dataset is converted into a management-level interpretation of what changed, why it matters and what should be watched next.</p>
          <div class="insight-tags"><span>Capacity</span><span>Digitalization</span><span>Security</span><span>Energy</span><span>Logistics</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="exec-bottom">
        <div class="card"><h3>Top 5 Maritime Developments</h3><div id="topEvents" class="top5-list"></div></div>
        <div class="card" id="allVerifiedCard"><h3>Verified Developments</h3><div id="allVerified" class="table-wrap"></div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="page" id="map">
      <div class="hero"><div><h1>Global Maritime Intelligence Map</h1><p>Geographic concentration of strategic maritime developments. Select a marker to inspect the underlying intelligence record.</p></div></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="map" id="mapCanvas"><div class="map-help">Click a bubble for full intelligence • Bubble size = Priority Score</div><div class="worldmap-bg"><svg xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="864pt" height="348pt" viewBox="0 0 864 348" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" version="1.1">
